This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who worked as a [[Security Guard/Legends|guard]] at [[Cloud Paradise]], an affluent residential building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Garik Loran]], the leader of the recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], went to Cloud Paradise to meet with [[Zehrinne Thaal]], one of its residents. The guard scanned Loran's [[Identichip/Legends|identicard]], and read all of the information displayed on his monitor, then summoned the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] and granted Loran access to the building.<ref name="MK" />
